name: Marcus Webb
personal_statement: My fieldwork in volcanic rift zones and sub-Arctic permafrost has given me experience that translates directly to planetary surface operations. I understand isolation, equipment failure, and working in hostile environments with limited resupply. I am a scientist who learned to fly because I wanted to go where the best samples are. Space is where the best samples are.
psychological_profile: Candidate is intellectually driven and highly motivated. Performs well on independent tasks. Some hesitation observed in collaborative pressure scenarios — recommends additional crew resource management training before mission assignment. Assessment conducted by Dr. Helen Ashworth (h.ashworth@rgs-eval.org); flag for the panel to reach her directly with any scoring questions.
